page.overview:
Who is Frederick?

Much like in his original appearance in Crypt of the NecroDancer, he can be fought as an enemy if struck by an explosive or if an arrow is fired at him, which he hints at with his warning towards , , , or to watch where they place their inside his shop. If struck by one, he will begin to chase the heroes and attack them. Unlike other enemies, he can move on every beat and move in any direction, including diagonally. When hit, he'll teleport a few spaces away and leave a directly under their feet. He'll also use a bow to fire arrows at the heroes whenever they're out of reach.

Upon defeat, he drops a which can be used to buy any item for free, though using it to buy his goods will cause him to attack. He can also be encountered in , where he drops a instead.
